text.p: Brief profile of Anna Kournikova of Russia who beat Iva Majoli of Croatia in the quarter-finals of the women's singles at Wimbledon on Wednesday.
Kournikova, who turned 16 last month, has never reached a singles semifinal at a women's tournament since turning professional in October 1995.
She becomes the second youngest player to reach the semifinals in the women's singles at Wimbledon after Jennifer Capriati who was 15 years and three months when she reached the same stage in 1991.
At age 14, she became the youngest player to compete and win in Fed Cup competition in the first tie of 1996, helping Russia defeat Sweden 3-0.
She was last year's most impressive newcomer on the women's tour.
Born in Moscow, Kournikova lives in Florida where she attends Nick Bollettieri's tennis school.

Unseeded. Age: 16. Plays: Right-handed. Weight: 50kg. Height: 1.68 metres. Ranking: 42. Tournament wins: 0. Head-to-head: First meeting. Career prize money: $205,659. Next opponent: Martina Hingis (Switzerland).
